Merlin tilted his head like he was actually considering it for a moment, then grinned. “No.” Arthur was starting to get the feeling that Merlin could probably beat Morgana on stubbornness if he really felt like it. *** Merlin grew up among the druids, learning his magic from the elders there, from the other magic users who filled the camp.
